picks.what: The city across the River Suir from the northwest, photochrom print (Library of Congress)
picks.why: color general view of the quays, the old bridge and the town’s spires across the Suir; border and caption trimmed

picks.what: Street in the city center, photograph
picks.why: only modern photograph of the city itself; Georgian shopfronts and a domed tower, taken June 2003 (date field is the upload)

notes: #5 (from the east, 1890s) is an equally good photochrom alternative to #6; #3 and #4 are quay scenes. #1, #2 are Cappoquin and Dunmore in County Waterford, not the city. #7 is Waterford, Pennsylvania. #9 is countryside from the Comeragh Mountains. #8 is a plain street scene with parked cars; drop it if a stronger modern view is wanted.
